description: SEC Form 144 notices of proposed sale by insiders (officers, directors, 10%+ holders): one row per planned-sale line of a filing. aggregate_market_value and approximate_sale_date are the filer's estimates; the value is as filed: null = not stated (a filed 0 stays 0), and some filers state the issuer's market cap. aggregate_market_value_check says which ('checked' = implies a plausible price; misses some). A ticker search also covers symbols the issuer no longer lists. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_planned_insider_sales

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

sort_by.description: Default filing_date. A value sort takes no since/until; nulls last.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

name: get_planned_insider_sales
